elements.name: title
elements.text: Compass prepares context; Genesys routes the call

elements.name: service-subtitle
elements.text: First service: use an agreed post-authentication intent checkpoint.

elements.name: context-service-features
elements.text:
Proposed Compass feature	What the service provides	Delivery boundary
Trusted intent
and identity	Interpret the agreed intent and
validate caller/service authority.	Confirm intent producer and
trusted identity propagation.
Atlas context
service	Return permitted context, status,
freshness and an approved route class.	Validate required fields, access
and data coverage.
Context delivery
and fallback	Deliver context to an authorized
CSR or accepted AI destination.	Genesys enforces routing and
fallback; late results cannot reroute.

elements.name: service-integration
elements.text: SDK / adapter or direct API: validate hosting, identity and the wait budget.
